accessibility.evidence: Targeted browser checks: labelled native forms; main focus after route change; modal initial focus, explicit Tab/Shift+Tab looping, Escape/return focus; conflict and confirmed settings feedback focus. Native semantics and UID/privacy regression tests pass. This is not a full conformance audit.

responsive.evidence: Observed 320/360/768/1366 widths, long assessment title, mobile list and selected-day weekends, tablet table, desktop sidebar/week. Recorded document scrollWidth <= innerWidth. True 200% zoom remains unverified.

loading.evidence: Real emulator registration displayed Opening your account / Loading your private profile; existing loading component/provider tests pass.

empty.evidence: Initial empty dashboard, no class times, blocked prerequisites and zero budgets; browser no-results filter view and pure zero-data tests pass.

error.evidence: Browser incorrect-password local sign-in showed error and retained email; component tests retain denied/conflicting profile drafts.

partial.evidence: Rendered AccountPage profile-error fixture preserves the original name and retries profile setup without registering again; executed existing regression test. Not claimed as a new manual backend fault-injection run.

success.evidence: Real local emulator registration/sign-in and server-confirmed budget saves observed; success focus verified. Preview updates explicitly say updated in preview.

permission.evidence: Executed settings denied-save UI regression keeps draft/no success; AuthGate and preview session-error/UID-switch tests; 43 real-emulator schema/owner rule tests pass. Not claimed as a manually injected browser permission fault.
